label: director of
definition: The first person is or was a director of the second organization.
scope_notes: The director family clearly dominates the full dictionary, matching the earlier specific-director scope. President/head/chief, analyst, founder or performer alone do not substitute for an explicit directorship. Broader leadership would be an alternative predicate, not an automatic union.

facts.reason: The majority/Democratic modifier path supplies neither a directorship nor a target organization of which Mitchell is director.
Horton is explicitly director of the Citizens Budget Commission; president/head rows add other leadership titles without weakening the direct support.
Terry is explicitly director of Operation Rescue. Founder is additional role evidence.
The two direct F.B.I. director paths identify Mueller in the declared role; the job-taking path alone would be insufficient.
Bergsten is directly described as director of the Institute for International Economics.
